label: Bible Study
prompt: Not of works, lest any man should _____.
verse: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
note: The sequel to 'by grace are ye saved' — so nobody gets bragging rights.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never _____; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
verse: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
note: Jesus offers a Samaritan woman at a well water that ends thirst for good — a spring inside you.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the _____ and harp.
verse: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.
note: The Bible's final psalm calls out the whole band — trumpet, psaltery, harp, and then everything that has breath.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in _____ of life.
verse: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
note: Baptism as burial and resurrection: down into death with Christ, up again to walk a brand-new life.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Only be thou strong and very _____, that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest.
verse: Only be thou strong and very courageous, that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest.
note: 'Be strong and of a good courage' appears in 1:6 and 1:9 — but 1:7 turns it up: 'very courageous.'
